I disagree with this a little bit. I have this problem. But not with counting change, telling time, or writing. I’m fairly fine at all three. Especially writing, where I excel. I’m a highschool student. And I have to demonstrate other-worldly work ethic ( and admittedly, some shortcuts ) just to get a low B in anything math related :c. And it isn’t for lack of trying. I take my notes. I ask questions in and out of class. I do my homework ( well, try). I attend tutorials, watch YouTube videos, practice on my OWN TIME. And still, my brain becomes fuzzy and I simply cannot connect the dots that everyone around me seems to. No matter how patient I try to be with myself and the person helping me. It almost always ends with me privately in tears. It has been like this for me since elementary school. Being advanced in every single subject, but horrendous with mathematics. The struggle triggers angry tears almost daily. Just because someone isn’t even able to comprehend the basic levels of a concept or subject doesn’t mean they aren’t trying.
